user.title: Sign in to Soundtrack
user.description: Use the Soundtrack account that should control these sound zones. The password is used once and is not saved. Home Assistant refreshes the session until Soundtrack revokes it.

data_description.email: The email you use at soundtrackyourbrand.com.
data_description.password: Used once to sign in. It is not stored.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Soundtrack
reauth_confirm.description: Soundtrack ended the saved session for {email}. Enter the password to sign in again.

error.invalid_auth: Soundtrack rejected that email or password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Soundtrack. Check the network and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Soundtrack account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: That password belongs to a different Soundtrack user.

play_playlist.name: Play playlist
play_playlist.description: Start a playlist on a sound zone now.

playlist_id.name: Playlist ID
playlist_id.description: Soundtrack playlist id, from the media browser or the Soundtrack app.

favorite_playlist.name: Favorite playlist
favorite_playlist.description: Save a playlist to this sound zone's account. It then shows up under Favorites and in the source list.

playlist_id.name: Playlist ID
playlist_id.description: Soundtrack playlist id to add to the account music library.

unfavorite_playlist.name: Unfavorite playlist
unfavorite_playlist.description: Remove a playlist from this sound zone's account music library.

playlist_id.name: Playlist ID
playlist_id.description: Soundtrack playlist id to remove from the account music library.
